name: T 72A Obr 1980
axis_orientation: rear-end is the engine deck / exhaust, front-end is the glacis and gun muzzle
operating_principle: The T-72A main battle tank is a tracked vehicle powered by a 840hp diesel engine, featuring torsion bar suspension and a 125mm smoothbore gun. It is operated by a crew of three, including a driver, a gunner, and a commander.

components.description: The hull structure of the vehicle houses a driver’s cab at the front, a fighting section in the centre and a power pack at the rear.
The turret features cast steel with laminate armor and additional neutron absorbing layers from 1984.

components.part_name: Main gun barrel with thermal sleeve
components.description: The tank is equipped with a 125mm smoothbore gun.
The tank features an automatic loading system.
The tank is powered by a 840hp diesel engine and features a hydraulically assisted manual transmission.

components.part_name: Running gear (drive sprocket, road wheels, idler, tracks, to
components.description: The tank features torsion bar suspension and a live track system.
The tank features a 1A40 fire control system and various sights, including a TPD-K1 laser range finder.
The tank features additional neutron absorbing layers and laminate armor.
